summary: Unpinned GitHub dependency resolved from a third-party user repo on install
details: package.json declares `dependencies.libsignal` as `github:RahmadTenpoles/libsignal-node` with no commit SHA, so `npm install raiden-baileys` fetches whatever is currently on the default branch of that third-party GitHub account and runs any lifecycle scripts inside it. The source bypasses the npm registry's provenance/integrity surface, is mutable by the owner of the referenced GitHub account at any time, and is unrelated to the typical publisher of libsignal-node. The bytes resolved on install are not pinned, not hash-verified, and are not necessarily what is shipped in this tarball.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
